{#- The 2027 conference header menu, like community/navbar.html for the community pages. Each year has its own copy, because the menu names the year's events; the shared conference/ templates import the one for the page's year. `menu` lists it once; navbar_items() renders it in the bar across the top, and offcanvas_items() in the slide-in menu on small screens. An item, or a whole dropdown, with `show` appears only when that's true, usually a flag from the conference's config. The logistics pages join the menu with the attendee guide, the program with the speakers or schedule, the grants and volunteer pages with their forms, and Convince Your Manager with the ticket sale. `page` is relative to the conference, so "cfp" is conf///cfp. Import it with the page's context, which holds the conference's config: {% from year_str ~ "/navbar.html" import navbar_items, offcanvas_items with context %} -#} {%- set menu = [ {'text': 'Program', 'page': 'schedule', 'show': flagspeakersannounced or flaghasschedule, 'children': [ {'text': 'Schedule', 'page': 'schedule', 'show': flaghasschedule}, {'text': 'Speakers', 'page': 'speakers', 'show': flagspeakersannounced}, {'text': 'Call for Proposals', 'page': 'cfp', 'show': flagcfp}, {'text': 'Community Day', 'page': 'community-day', 'show': flaghascommunityday}, {'text': 'Unconference', 'page': 'unconference', 'show': flaghasunconf}, {'text': 'Lightning Talks', 'page': 'lightning-talks', 'show': flaghaslightningtalks}, {'text': 'Hike', 'page': 'hike', 'show': flaghashike}, {'text': 'tickets', 'children': [ {'text': 'Tickets', 'page': 'tickets'}, {'text': 'Virtual Attendance', 'page': 'virtual'}, {'text': 'Opportunity Grants', 'page': 'opportunity-grants', 'show': grants.url}, {'text': 'Convince Your Manager', 'page': 'convince-your-manager', 'show': flagticketsonsale}, ]}, {'text': 'About', 'page': 'about', 'children': [ {'text': 'What is Write the Docs?', 'page': 'index',
